primary_math: Use a congruent cube [-1,1]^3. At vertex (1,1,1), the three adjacent vertices lie in x+y+z=1. All eight cuts leave the center in the intersection of signed inequalities sx*x+sy*y+sz*z<=1 for sx,sy,sz in {-1,1}. This is exactly |x|+|y|+|z|<=1, the regular octahedron with vertices (+/-1,0,0),(0,+/-1,0),(0,0,+/-1), eight triangular faces. Original square faces shrink to single axis vertices. Thus A alone, not the shallower corner-truncated cube C with six octagonal original-face remnants. The new triangle DBE is exactly one explicitly requested cut, not an extra cut. Colors have no equality or cut-depth semantics.
